facts.quote: On December 12, 2023, Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (the “Company,” “HPE,” or “we”) was notified that a suspected nation-state actor, believed to be the threat actor Midnight Blizzard, the state-sponsored actor also known as Cozy Bear, had gained unauthorized access to HPE’s cloud-based email environment.
facts.note: Company was notified by an unnamed party.

facts.quote: the Company now understands this incident is likely related to earlier activity by this threat actor, of which we were notified in June 2023, involving unauthorized access to and exfiltration of a limited number of SharePoint files as early as May 2023
facts.note: Earlier, likely-related activity by the same actor was notified in June 2023; the Company treats the December 2023 notification as the discovery of the current incident.

facts.quote: Based on our investigation, we now believe that the threat actor accessed and exfiltrated data beginning in May 2023 from a small percentage of HPE mailboxes belonging to individuals in our cybersecurity, go-to-market, business segments, and other functions.
facts.note: Mailbox access began May 2023; related SharePoint activity also 'as early as May 2023'.

summary: HPE discloses that on December 12, 2023 it was notified that the suspected state-sponsored actor Midnight Blizzard (Cozy Bear) had accessed its cloud email environment and, beginning May 2023, exfiltrated data from a small percentage of mailboxes; the activity is likely linked to a June 2023 SharePoint exfiltration previously judged immaterial. The activity has been eradicated, law enforcement is involved, the investigation continues, and no material operational or financial impact has been determined.
